# Agent HUD 0.4.34-beta.4
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.4 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
If the required iPhone version is not yet on the App Store, cross-device features require the corresponding TestFlight version.
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
- The New Version menu entry uses blue text while keeping the regular menu font.

# Agent HUD 0.4.35
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.4 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
### Antigravity
- Refresh quota summaries directly to avoid stale limits and reset times. - Correct local Token accounting, including cache writes and thinking tokens, and match usage to its recorded timestamps more accurately. - Fix false local-session warnings caused by summary databases and failed generations without Token usage. Records that genuinely cannot be verified still show a warning. - Show account-wide reading warnings on the current account instead of repeating them under retained accounts. - Answer native permission requests from the HUD with Allow once or Deny. Requests answered in Antigravity disappear automatically; dismissing a request leaves its native prompt unanswered.
### Other improvements
- Codex completion reminders use the current conversation title and show a short final-reply preview when available. - Check for new versions when the Mac app starts and every hour. - Support one-year gift licenses and upgrading the original gift key to lifetime access while keeping existing device activations.
